spans.s: अकृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Not prepared; 2. not accomplished; 3. not made or created.
अकृत (II) n. An unheard of action.
अकृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Not prepared; 2. not accomplished; 3. not made or created.
अकृता f. A daughter not placed on a level with sons.
अकृत-आत्मन् a. 1. who has not subdued his senses; 2. who has not attained union with God.
अकृत-बुद्धि a. having an unformed mind.
अकृष्ट-पच्य, -रोहिन् a. ripening or growing in unploughed land, growing wild, अकृष्टपच्या इव शस्यसंपदः Kir.i.17, R.xiv.77.
अकृष्ट-पच्य, -रोहिन् a. ripening or growing in unploughed land, growing wild, अकृष्टपच्या इव शस्यसंपदः Kir.i.17, R.xiv.77.

आकृति f. 1. Form, figure, गोवर्धनस्याकृतिरन्वकारि Sis.iii.4; 2. the body, किमिव हि मधुराणां मण्डनं नाकृतीनाम् Sak.i.; 3. appearance (बहिराकार आकृति), often noble appearance, e.g. यत्राकृतिस्तत्र गुणा वसन्ति; 4. tribe, species.
आकृति-गण m. a list of words belonging to a certain grammatical rule which does not exhibit every word belonging to that rule but only specimens, e.g. स्वरादिगणः, चादिगणः.
आकृष्टि f. 1. Attraction, gravitation, आकृष्टिशक्तिश्च मही तया यत् खस्थं गुरु स्वाभिमिखं स्वशक्त्या । आकृष्यते तत्पतीव भाति समे समंतात् क्व पतत्वियं खे Bhāskara.; 2. bending of a bow, Am.
